title: Pause Wrap Dress M/L and send fit-spec revision to Ege Jersey

set.storefront_badge: Back soon in a refined fit

writes.subject: Wrap Dress fit-spec revision: sizes M and L
writes.body: 71% of M/L returns cite size_too_small (64% return rate vs 22-26% in XS/S/XL). Please re-check the M and L grade rules for bust, waist and hip against the base sample, and send revised M/L fit samples before the next bulk cut. XS/S/XL unchanged.

impact.method: scenario step 19 (fix_fit: 4-month pause, relaunch at 32% return rate)

risks: Post-fix return rate of 32% is an assumption; XS/S/XL run 22-26%. If the fix only reaches 45%, most of the gain disappears.
Pausing M/L is roughly CM-neutral on its own (-$1.5k/yr if permanent); it is justified by customer experience, not margin.
4-month pause assumes one sampling round; a second round extends it.
M/L demand during the pause is assumed lost (no substitution to other sizes).
checks_performed: incremental vs allocated CM of paused sizes
